LanguageData.Gun_MP-3008_RWP.description: The MP-3008 is a compact submachine gun inspired by a historic design, known for its rugged simplicity and ease of manufacture. Designed for close-quarters combat, it offers a high rate of fire at the cost of accuracy over longer distances. Ideal for colonists in need of a reliable automatic weapon for defense and short-range engagements.
